crypto_headlines.title: BTC ETFs keep inflows while ETH, SOL and XRP funds see outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $110.34M on Oct. 26, while ETH ETFs saw $88.58M leave, SOL $8.23M and XRP $3.61M.

crypto_headlines.title: Ripple gets OCC approval for a national trust bank
crypto_headlines.summary: CoinDesk reports Ripple received OCC approval to launch Ripple National Trust Bank, making it a federally chartered trust institution in the US.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance files for a crypto license in Brazil
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance applied to Brazil's central bank to operate as a virtual asset service provider ahead of the Oct. 30 deadline, and per Wu Blockchain is restricting 8 services and delisting 22 tokens there.

crypto_headlines.title: SBI and BlackRock explore tokenized funds with a yen stablecoin
crypto_headlines.summary: SBI Group and BlackRock signed an MOU to explore connecting BlackRock's tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin JPYSC.

crypto_headlines.title: Crypto industry has spent about $176M on US midterm races
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Reuters, the crypto industry has spent roughly $176M across more than 100 US midterm races to build bipartisan support in Congress.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance says it blocked North Korea-linked attacks
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance said its security team identified and blocked multiple North Korea-linked cyberattacks over the past week, with no asset losses.

doginal_news.title: Marketplace listing flaw drains dogs
doginal_news.summary: JonXDG says a design flaw in a Doginal Dogs marketplace's listing signatures let anyone take listed dogs without paying, and counts 201 dogs drained, including his #6398. If you have open listings there, check them.

doginal_news.title: DDLTCG boxes land in Australia
doginal_news.summary: Koa shared that boxes of the Doginal Dogs Legends Trading Card Game arrived in Australia and thanked the DDLTCG team for making it happen.

doginal_news.title: New Boogie full art page
doginal_news.summary: homeMetaX shared a Boogie full art page for DDLTCG, one card with eight inserts extending the artwork, and @DDLTCG reposted it.

doginal_news.title: The real people behind DDL card names
doginal_news.summary: BooMetaX pointed out that many Legends card names belong to real people and pets in the community, and asked players for their favorite card. @DDLTCG reposted it.

doginal_news.title: Pyth's 24/7 Anthropic index after the S-1 filing
doginal_news.summary: After Anthropic filed its S-1, Pyth highlighted its 24/7 Anthropic index that exchanges and prediction platforms can use to power their markets.

doginal_news.title: Brazil ETF perps priced on Pyth after the runoff
doginal_news.summary: MSB Intel reports perps on BlackRock's Brazil ETF (EWZ) traded $218M between Sunday's runoff poll close and the US morning, 99% priced on Pyth. Pyth reposted it.

notes: Doginal Dogs and DDLTCG items are from community posts the official accounts reposted or that we checked on X in the last 24 hours.
